claim_boundary: Existing broad and fresh C8 outcome surfaces are reused after their outcomes were already observed. This analysis can diagnose transfer failure and choose one future policy to preregister, but cannot confirm that policy.

inputs.shared_action_pre_eligibility: unconditional 16 documents x layers 0..14 at the same frozen victim position; no outcome filter

action_pre_features.normalization: broad-fit-only population mean/std; held-out and fresh never refit

cell_head.features: mean action-pre vector per cell, excluding intercept and constant rank block
cell_head.selection: global predicted mu descending, then cell_identity ascending, exact B

rank_residual_ridge.features: action-pre vector minus within-cell mean action-pre vector
rank_residual_ridge.selection: maximum predicted residual within each selected cell; tie smallest rank

harm_head.selection_for_diagnostic: minimum predicted harm within each selected cell; tie smallest rank
harm_head.effective_if: fresh MSE skill versus broad-train-mean constant is positive AND exact selected-cell harm avoidance is positive

hierarchical_static_rank_profile.name: HierarchicalStaticRankProfile-v1
hierarchical_static_rank_profile.selection: maximum broad-fitted profile score within each selected fresh cell; tie smallest rank

evaluation.train_side: 16-fold leave-one-document-out cross-fit over broad; no tuning
evaluation.fresh_side: one full-broad fit evaluated once on the existing document-disjoint fresh surface
evaluation.primary_cell_set: exact top-B cells selected by the corresponding cell-head predictions
evaluation.profile_rank_gain_primary: profile rank gain on the fresh cell-head top-B cell set
evaluation.expectations: exact rational arithmetic; no Monte Carlo

decision.missing_branch_resolution_frozen_pre_res: A positive harm diagnostic alone does not create a third harm-only policy. This prevents post-result policy shopping.
decision.future_confirmation_requirement: Any selected policy must be sealed before C8 outcomes on a third, fully new document-disjoint cohort.
